# Pixel Memory Match

A fully offline, accessible pixel-art memory match game built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No external dependencies, assets, or network requests.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total), shuffled each game
- Flip two cards at a time; matched pairs stay face up
- Move counter and win message
- "New Game" button to restart
- Keyboard accessible: Tab to navigate, Enter/Space to flip cards
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- Cohesive pixel-art palette with hover, focus, and pressed states

## Technical Notes

- Files: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `script.js`, `README.md`
- No inline event handlers; all listeners added via `addEventListener`
- ARIA live region for move count and win message
- Cards have ARIA labels and grid roles
- CSS-drawn color swatches (no images)

## Testing

- Verified offline functionality (no network requests)
- Keyboard-only play tested
- Responsive layout checked at 360px
- Rapid clicking prevented via `lockBoard` flag
